trail_en: A homeless ex-coworker 'marries' the defendant's live-in girlfriend on paper.
Same night: a NT$5M injury policy on him — premium just NT$5,670.
Three months later he's hit by a car; he dies weeks later.
The 'wife' files the claim. The defendant? Says he was out shrimp fishing.
trail_zh: 一名街友前同事，跟被告的同居女友「登記結婚」。
當晚就幫他投保500萬傷害險，保費只要5,670元。
三個月後他在路上被車撞，幾週後過世。
「太太」出面申請理賠；被告說他那時在釣蝦場。
cracks_en: An agent asked to meet the insured before signing
Headlight glass from a dumped stolen car matched the scene
The 'married couple' never slept on the same floor
The insurer refused to pay out on the NT$5M policy
cracks_zh: 業務員要求簽約前先見被保人本人
棄置贓車的大燈碎片，和現場碎片吻合
這對「夫妻」從沒睡在同一層樓
保險公司拒絕理賠這張500萬保單
reveal_en: Sham marriage, policy, stolen car — all one plan. Murder conviction upheld: life imprisonment; the girlfriend got 12 years, the helper 10.5.
reveal_zh: 假結婚、投保、偷車撞人，全是同一盤計畫。殺人罪定讞，主嫌無期徒刑；同居女友12年、幫手10年6月。

source.id: 最高法院106年度台上字第2808號刑事判決

trail_en: Two new policies in May and June, plus a travel policy two days before the incident.
He says a branch on the median strip pierced his eye as he drove, then he hit the guardrail.
Three insurers pay about NT$3.5M; two refuse.
He also sues the government for state compensation over the 'dangerous tree'.
trail_zh: 5月、6月各新買一張保單，事發前兩天再加保旅平險。
他說開車時被分隔島樹枝刺進眼睛，接著撞上護欄。
三家保險公司共賠約350萬，兩家拒賠。
他還以「路樹危險」向政府請求國家賠償。
cracks_en: His dashcam shows him crawling along the median by bushes
He had held insurance policies going back to 1990
Two insurers refused to pay out on his eye-injury claim
He filed a state-compensation lawsuit and lost it
cracks_zh: 行車紀錄器拍到他貼著分隔島慢開
他從1990年起就一直有在買保單
兩家保險公司拒絕理賠他的眼傷
他打了國家賠償官司，結果敗訴
reveal_en: He injured his own eye on purpose. Fraud: 1 year, final.
reveal_zh: 眼傷是他故意造成的。詐欺罪，判1年定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院108年度上易字第2383號刑事判決

trail_en: Five days before: two travel policies, NT$10M each — for a solo drive to the next district.
He'd bounced cheques; his family says he rarely told them where he went.
Drove 2.3 km in 47 minutes, doubled back once, then left the road on a downhill bend.
His wife claims double cover on his postal life policy. The insurer refuses.
trail_zh: 事發前5天，買了兩張各1,000萬的旅平險，結果只是一個人開車去隔壁區。
他有跳票紀錄；家人說他平常出門很少交代去哪。
2.3公里開了47分鐘，還折返一次，最後在下坡彎道衝出路外。
妻子依郵局壽險申請加倍給付，保險公司拒賠。
cracks_en: Both travel policies had the same start and end dates
He doubled back once on the road before the crash
Reconstruction found the tyre marks followed the bend
Police found no braking marks at the scene of the crash
cracks_zh: 兩張旅平險的起訖日期完全一樣
出事前他曾在路上折返一次
鑑定發現胎痕是順著彎道走的
警方說現場完全沒有煞車痕
reveal_en: The bend had a 15.8 m gap in the guardrail; the court found an accident. Insurer ordered to pay the extra NT$800K. Final.
reveal_zh: 彎道護欄有15.8公尺缺口，法院認定是意外，判保險公司加付80萬。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院111年度保險上易字第5號民事判決

trail_en: Older brother, a retired cop, holds policies on his younger brother at three insurers.
Two months earlier he bought a deregistered car with no plates.
The younger brother, out cycling, is hit from behind; the driver flees.
Older brother, as beneficiary, collects about NT$9.86M.
trail_zh: 退休警察哥哥，在三家保險公司幫弟弟保了險。
事發兩個月前，他買了一台已報廢、沒掛牌的車。
弟弟騎腳踏車時被從後方撞上，肇事車逃逸。
受益人哥哥領到約985萬元保險金。
cracks_en: The car's red trunk lid had been repainted grey
The car was later dumped in the hills and set on fire
Insurers were still holding back some of the injury claims
A scrap-sale contract tied the burned car back to him
cracks_zh: 車子紅色後車廂蓋被重漆成灰色
車子事後被丟在山區放火燒掉
部分傷害理賠仍被保險公司扣著
報廢車契約把燒毀的車連到他
reveal_en: The 'hit-and-run' was the brother all along. Murder for insurance: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 「肇逃」的駕駛就是哥哥本人。殺人詐保，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院104年度台上字第994號刑事判決

trail_en: Policies bought in March, September and October 2012 — over NT$10M of cover.
January 2013: he reports losing fingertips while using a meat grinder.
Insurers pay out at least NT$1.29M.
Paramedics found the grinder unplugged. Later he blamed a grass trimmer instead.
trail_zh: 2012年3月、9月、10月陸續投保，保額超過1,000萬。
2013年1月，他說手指被絞肉機絞斷。
保險公司至少賠了129萬多。
救護人員到場時絞肉機插頭沒插；後來他又改口是割草機。
cracks_en: The grinder was unplugged when the paramedics arrived
Forensics found clean breaks and nails left intact
He later changed his story and blamed a grass trimmer
His total insurance cover added up to over NT$10M
cracks_zh: 救護人員到場時，絞肉機根本沒插電
法醫說斷面整齊、指甲也都完整
他後來改口說是被割草機弄傷的
他的總保額加起來超過1,000萬
reveal_en: The injury was deliberate. Fraud: aggregate 1 year 2 months, final.
reveal_zh: 傷是故意弄的。詐欺罪，應執行1年2月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院106年度上易字第308號刑事判決

trail_en: A wife holds life and injury policies on her husband; she's the beneficiary.
He's found drowned in a shallow roadside ditch.
The insurer pays the NT$500K life part but refuses the NT$1M injury part.
Its argument: a healthy adult can't drown in water that shallow.
trail_zh: 妻子幫丈夫保了壽險加傷害險，自己是受益人。
丈夫被發現溺斃在路旁淺水溝。
保險公司付了50萬壽險，卻拒付100萬傷害險。
理由：健康成年人不可能在那麼淺的水裡溺死。
cracks_en: The man who drowned had a history of epilepsy
The ditch where it happened was quite a shallow one
The autopsy found a forehead bruise and a scraped knee
Even the insurer's lawyer had no proof it wasn't an accident
cracks_zh: 死者生前本來就有癲癇的病史
他溺水的那條水溝其實不深
解剖發現額頭瘀傷和膝蓋擦傷
保險公司律師承認拿不出任何反證
reveal_en: Another insurer had already paid. Court: accident — pay NT$1M plus 10% interest. Final.
reveal_zh: 另一家保險公司早就理賠了。法院認定意外，判賠100萬加年息10%。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院96年度保險上易字第1號民事判決

trail_en: Spring: a wife takes out policies on her husband — without his consent.
She has gambling debts from illegal lottery bets.
He's hospitalised; weeks later he dies in a private room she'd moved him to.
She calls the insurer again and again, and petitions prosecutors four times for the death certificate.
trail_zh: 春天，妻子未經同意幫丈夫投保多張保單。
她簽六合彩欠下賭債。
丈夫住院，幾週後在她要求換的單人病房過世。
她一再打給保險公司，還四度向檢方聲請死亡證明。
cracks_en: A nurse noticed his IV fluid had turned a cloudy orange
She had him moved into a private room at the hospital
She kept pressing the insurer to pay out on the claim
A saved IV bag held pesticide and unprescribed drugs
cracks_zh: 護理師發現點滴變成混濁的橘色
她特地把丈夫轉到單人病房
她三番兩次催保險公司趕快理賠
點滴袋驗出農藥和沒開過的藥
reveal_en: She tampered with his IV twice. Murder for insurance — death sentence, upheld.
reveal_zh: 她兩度在點滴裡動手腳。殺人詐保，死刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院102年度台上字第2392號刑事判決

trail_en: A business owner with NT$30M+ in debt buys three injury policies in nine days.
He searches online for how disability cover pays out. Days later: a crash.
Suit and flip-flops on a dry, sunny day — he tells police it was raining, and 'insurance will handle it.'
He asks doctors to amputate injured toes. Payout: about NT$9.47M.
trail_zh: 負債3,000多萬的老闆，9天內買了三張傷害險。
他上網查失能險怎麼賠，幾天後就出車禍。
大晴天穿西裝配拖鞋，卻跟警察說在下雨，還說「保險會處理」。
他要求醫師截掉受傷腳趾，領到約947萬。
cracks_en: A phone memo added up payouts from five policies
He was wearing flip-flops together with a suit
He told police it was raining on a clear sunny day
He asked the doctors to amputate his injured toes
cracks_zh: 手機備忘錄算好五張保單的錢
他穿西裝卻配了一雙拖鞋
大晴天他卻跟警察說在下雨
他主動要求醫師截掉受傷的腳趾
reveal_en: The plan was written down before the crash. Fraud: 3 years, final.
reveal_zh: 計畫早就寫在手機裡。詐欺罪，判3年定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院115年度上易字第914號刑事判決

trail_en: An unmarried factory worker who also farms has an injury rider worth NT$1M; his sister is the beneficiary.
Before dawn he drinks from a plastic bottle by his bed. It's weedkiller.
The insurer refuses: a farmer would know that smell.
In hospital he insists he grabbed it by mistake and says he has work tomorrow.
trail_zh: 未婚、在藥廠上班兼務農的男子有100萬傷害險附約，受益人是妹妹。
天亮前他拿床邊寶特瓶喝了一口，裡面是除草劑。
保險公司拒賠：務農的人不可能聞不出來。
他在醫院堅稱是拿錯，還說明天要上班。
cracks_en: He was in the habit of drinking heavily at night
A pesticide lab found the bottle had no strong smell
He had nearly NT$1M in savings and no debts at all
Days earlier he texted friends asking about their weddings
cracks_zh: 他平常晚上都習慣喝上不少酒
檢驗所說那瓶農藥沒有刺鼻味
他有近百萬存款，也沒有任何負債
幾天前他還傳簡訊跟朋友問婚禮的事
reveal_en: Court: a mix-up in a cluttered room, not intent. Insurer ordered to pay NT$1M. Final.
reveal_zh: 法院認定是在雜亂房間裡拿錯瓶子，不是故意，判保險公司賠100萬。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院100年度保險上易字第24號民事判決

trail_en: 2019: a cousin buys a life policy in her relative's name, then switches the beneficiary to herself.
More injury and travel cover follows — NT$5M of it bought the very day of the crash.
He's lured out by a fake call 'from the farmers' association' and hit by a scrap car with stolen plates.
He survives. No claim is ever filed.
trail_zh: 2019年，表姊用表弟名義投保壽險，再把受益人改成自己。
接著加保傷害險、旅平險——其中500萬是車禍當天才買的。
他被冒稱「農會」的電話約出門，遭掛失竊車牌的報廢車撞擊。
他活了下來，最後沒人申請理賠。
cracks_en: She had paid over NT$170K in premiums on the policies
She later paid the victim NT$6.8M in a settlement
Police reviewing CCTV saw it didn't look like an accident
The hired driver was recruited on Facebook for NT$1M
cracks_zh: 她前後一共繳了17萬多元的保費
她事後跟被害人和解賠了680萬
警方調閱監視器，發現根本就不像意外
撞人的司機是用100萬在臉書找的
reveal_en: Forged signatures, a hired driver, a staged crash. The victim survived. Attempted murder for insurance — 5 years 2 months, final.
reveal_zh: 偽簽投保、雇人開車、製造車禍。被害人幸運活了下來。殺人未遂，判5年2月定讞。

source.id: 最高法院112年度台上字第828號刑事判決（事實見111年度台上字第2973號）

trail_en: Jul 2007–Feb 2008: an older father gets 12 policies on himself, partly through an ex-employer and a friend's company.
Injury and disability cover tops NT$68.5M.
March 2008: his hand is crushed in a metal press at the friend's tiny workshop.
One insurer and labour insurance pay about NT$1.39M; ten insurers refuse.
trail_zh: 2007年7月到2008年2月，年長的父親替自己保了12張保單，部分透過前雇主和朋友公司投保。
傷害失能保額超過6,850萬。
2008年3月，他在朋友的小鐵工廠被沖床壓碎手掌。
一家保險公司加勞保共賠約139萬，另外十家拒賠。
cracks_en: Premiums of NT$200K+ a year on NT$250–400K income
He had no real work to do at the workshop that day
His account of how the press started kept changing
Ten of his twelve insurers refused to pay the claims
cracks_zh: 保費年繳20萬，所得25至40萬
那天他到工廠，其實根本沒事要做
沖床到底怎麼啟動，他說法一變再變
十二家保險公司裡，有十家都拒絕理賠
reveal_en: He wanted money for his young son's future and staged the injury himself. Fraud: 1 year 2 months on appeal, final.
reveal_zh: 他想替年幼兒子攢教育費，自己製造傷殘。詐欺罪，二審改判1年2月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院102年度上易字第678號刑事判決

trail_en: A man has a NT$1M group injury policy; his mother is the beneficiary.
He's found face-down at home, wedged in a narrow gap beside his bed.
Tests find sleeping pills — and traces of heroin from the day before.
The insurer refuses: overdose, not an outside cause.
trail_zh: 男子有100萬團體傷害險，受益人是母親。
他被發現趴在家中床邊的狹窄縫隙裡。
檢驗出安眠藥，還有前一天施用海洛因的痕跡。
保險公司拒賠：是用藥過量，非外來事故。
cracks_en: He had a known history of liver disease
No drug paraphernalia was found in his home
He had once been sent to compulsory drug rehab
The examiner said the drug level wasn't lethal
cracks_zh: 他生前就有肝臟方面的病史
在他家裡找不到任何吸毒器具
他之前曾經被裁定觀察勒戒過
相驗法醫作證，毒品濃度不足以致命
reveal_en: Court: the main cause was positional suffocation — an accident. Insurer ordered to pay NT$1M. Final.
reveal_zh: 法院認定主因是姿勢性窒息，屬意外，判保險公司賠100萬。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院105年度保險上易字第8號民事判決

trail_en: A former paper-delivery man suddenly owns a steakhouse and a NT$10M+ home.
Sep 2013–Apr 2014: nine policies on him, NT$46M+ of injury cover; a 'friend' pays the premiums.
1:57 a.m., by a lakeside road: he's hit by a rental car and dies.
A man walks up and tells police he was the driver.
trail_zh: 原本送報的男子，突然當上牛排店老闆，還貸款買了千萬房子。
2013年9月到隔年4月，投保9張保單，傷害險額度逾4,600萬，保費由「朋友」出。
凌晨1點57分，澄清湖環湖路，他被一輛租來的車撞擊身亡。
一名男子出面，向警方說車是他開的。
cracks_en: Phone logs caught an 'in position' call before impact
The car scraped the guardrail for 60 m without braking
The victim was on crutches from an earlier 'accident'
The car had only been rented earlier that same evening
cracks_zh: 撞擊前有人打電話回報「就定位」
車子沿護欄擦撞近60公尺都沒煞車
被害人因先前的「意外」拄著拐杖
那輛車是事發當天晚上才租來的
reveal_en: A former insurance agent set him up from the start; the 'driver' was a stand-in. Murder: mastermind life, three others 10–14.5 years, upheld.
reveal_zh: 前保險業務員一手布局，出面的「駕駛」是頂替。殺人罪定讞：主謀無期徒刑，另三人10年2月至14年6月。

source.id: 最高法院109年度台上字第1477號刑事判決（事實見臺灣高等法院高雄分院108年度上更二字第2號）

trail_en: A former insurance agent owing several million crashes into a guardrail, steps into traffic and is hit.
She settles with the other driver for a NT$5–6K red envelope.
Months later X-rays show healed bones and normal nerve tests — yet she arrives at clinics in a wheelchair.
Severe-disability certificates follow; insurers pay out more than NT$4.8M.
trail_zh: 負債數百萬的前保險業務員，自撞護欄後走到車道上被撞。
她跟對方駕駛只收了5、6千元紅包就和解。
幾個月後X光顯示骨折癒合、神經檢查正常，她看診時卻坐輪椅進診間。
她拿到重度失能診斷書，保險公司賠了超過480萬。
cracks_en: She settled with the other driver for a small red envelope
Covert video caught her getting into cars, crossing roads
She owed just one business partner some NT$6–7M
She walked into the road straight after her own crash
cracks_zh: 她只收了一個小紅包就跟對方駕駛和解
側錄影片拍到她自己上下車、過馬路
她光欠一個股東就六、七百萬
她自撞護欄後，馬上走進車道裡
reveal_en: The crash was real; the lasting disability was faked. Fraud: aggregate 3 years 6 months plus 7 months, final.
reveal_zh: 車禍是真的，失能是裝的。詐欺罪，分別應執行3年6月及7月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院111年度上易字第589號刑事判決（事實見臺灣嘉義地方法院110年度易字第326號）

trail_en: A building manager has daily hospital-cash cover at five insurers — about NT$20K a day in total.
Two of the policies started just days before the crash.
He's hit on his scooter, then stays at three hospitals in a row: 87 days.
Insurers pay for the first 24 days and refuse the last 63.
trail_zh: 大樓管理員在五家保險公司買了住院日額險，合計一天約2萬。
其中兩張在車禍前幾天才生效。
他騎機車被撞，接著連住三家醫院，共87天。
保險公司賠了前24天，後面63天拒賠。
cracks_en: NHI data: average stay for that surgery is 10.9 days
He checked out and back in on the same day, twice
His third hospital's doctor said inpatient care was needed
Labour insurance had already paid 78 days of sick benefit
cracks_zh: 健保資料：該手術平均住10.9天
他兩度當天出院、當天又住院
第三家醫院醫師作證，他確實需要住院
勞保已經給付他78天傷病給付
reveal_en: The car driver broke the traffic rules; the stays were doctor-ordered. Insurers ordered to pay NT$759K. Final.
reveal_zh: 是對方違規撞人，住院也是醫師判斷。法院判兩家保險公司共賠75萬9千元。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院96年度保險上易字第10號民事判決

trail_en: A man owes about NT$8M from illegal lottery bets.
Over two years he insures his own life for about NT$8.3M, his wife as beneficiary.
A rented car is found at the bottom of a coastal cliff, a body at the wheel in his clothes.
His wife identifies 'him' and collects NT$8.3M. Months later he walks back in the front door.
trail_zh: 男子簽六合彩，欠了親友約800萬。
兩年內替自己投保，總額約830萬，受益人是太太。
一台租來的車墜落蘇花公路斷崖，駕駛座上的屍體穿著他的衣服。
太太指認是「他」，領走830萬。幾個月後，他自己回家了。
cracks_en: He turned himself in, saying it was a hit-and-run in Yilan
The car had been rented only two days before it went over
The body was dressed in his clothes, watch and glasses
The dead man's father said he'd never once been to Yilan
cracks_zh: 他自首，說是在宜蘭撞到人才起意
那台車是出事前兩天才租的
屍體穿戴著他的衣服、手錶和眼鏡
死者父親說兒子從沒去過宜蘭
reveal_en: His 'accident' story collapsed: he had picked a stranger who resembled him and killed him to fake his own death. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 「車禍」說法不攻自破：他找了一個身形相似的陌生人殺害，假冒自己死亡。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院87年度台上字第2599號刑事判決

trail_en: A 2016 crash leaves a man with a fractured wrist.
The fracture heals, but he tells doctors his fingers no longer work.
Compulsory auto insurance pays NT$560K; labour insurance adds NT$317K.
The insurer then sues the other driver to recover the money. She smells a rat.
trail_zh: 2016年一場車禍，男子手腕骨折。
骨折癒合了，他卻跟醫師說手指不能動。
強制險賠了56萬，勞保又給了31萬多。
保險公司轉向對方駕駛求償，她覺得不對勁。
cracks_en: His fractured wrist had fully healed by the time he claimed
A fake 'delivery man' filmed him writing and peeling tape
Labour insurance had separately paid him NT$316,800
The insurer had gone after the other driver for its money
cracks_zh: 他申請理賠時，腕骨其實早已癒合
假送貨員拍到他寫字、撕膠帶
勞保另外給付了他31萬多元
保險公司回頭向對方駕駛求償
reveal_en: The other driver's brother posed as a courier and caught him using both hands. Fraud: 5 months in total, final.
reveal_zh: 對方駕駛的哥哥假扮送貨員，拍到他雙手靈活。詐欺罪，合計5個月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院110年度上易字第483號刑事判決

trail_en: A brand-new car, three months old, insured for NT$2.3M against damage.
Night, on the freeway: the driver says a shiny object flew over from the other side.
She drives on home without stopping or calling the highway police.
The repair bill is NT$779K. The insurer refuses: 12 evenly spaced holes don't fit her story.
trail_zh: 一台才買三個月的新車，車體險保額230萬。
夜間國道上，駕駛說有發亮物體從對向車道飛過來。
她沒停車也沒報國道警察，直接開回家。
修車花了77萬多。保險公司拒賠：12個等距破洞不合理。
cracks_en: She didn't stop or report it to the highway police that night
The underbody had 12 holes spaced about 16 cm apart
The damage ran in one straight line, bumper to underbody
She reported the incident online after midnight
cracks_zh: 她當晚沒有停車，也沒向警方報案
底盤有12個間隔約16公分的破洞
車損從保險桿到底盤連成一直線
她隔天凌晨才上網向警方報案
reveal_en: A straight line of damage is what you'd expect from running over debris at speed — and nobody wrecks a 3-month-old car on purpose. Insurer ordered to pay NT$778,550. Final.
reveal_zh: 高速碾過墜落物，本來就會留下一直線的損傷；也沒人會故意弄壞剛買三個月的新車。判保險公司賠77萬8,550元，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院114年度保險上易字第8號民事判決

trail_en: A foot-massage worker owes NT$5M from co-signing a friend's loan.
He insures his estranged wife with four new policies — NT$6M in total.
He calls her back from Taipei, saying his mother is ill and needs care.
Next day she's found drowned in a pond where he'd gone fishing. He's in the water shouting for help.
trail_zh: 做腳底按摩的男子，替朋友作保背了500萬債。
他替分居的妻子新買四張保單，合計600萬。
他騙妻子說婆婆生病，要她從台北回來照顧。
隔天妻子溺死在他釣魚的池塘，他泡在水裡喊救命。
cracks_en: The autopsy found smothering injuries to her gums and upper lip
He'd cancelled one policy to buy cover that paid out more
He'd been behind on his health-insurance premiums for years
A neighbour heard him shouting and ran to the pond
cracks_zh: 解剖發現牙齦和嘴唇有悶壓傷
他退掉一張保單，改買賠更多的
他已經欠繳健保費好幾年了
鄰居聽到呼救聲才趕到池塘邊
reveal_en: The water by the bank was too shallow to drown in; he held her under. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 岸邊水淺淹不死人，是他把她壓進水裡。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院102年度台上字第1273號刑事判決

trail_en: A university student is injured in a 2009 road crash.
Afterwards he says he's completely blind; he arrives at clinics with a cane, in a wheelchair.
Eye tests come back normal; one doctor notes malingering 'can't be ruled out'.
Three insurers pay NT$5.2M. He also sues the other driver for NT$13.8M.
trail_zh: 一名大學生在2009年車禍受傷。
之後他說自己全盲，拿著手杖、坐輪椅去看診。
眼睛檢查結果正常，醫師寫下「不排除裝病」。
三家保險公司賠了520萬，他還向對方駕駛求償1,384萬。
cracks_en: His eye tests kept coming back with normal results
A doctor wrote that malingering couldn't be ruled out
He also sued the other driver for more than NT$13 million
Blogs and Facebook posts showed him moving around freely
cracks_zh: 他的眼睛檢查結果一直都正常
醫師病歷寫著「不排除裝病」
他向對方駕駛求償超過1,300萬
部落格和臉書上的他行動自如
reveal_en: The other driver did the digging and found the posts. Fraud: 1 year 2 months, final.
reveal_zh: 是被求償的對方駕駛自己挖出那些貼文。詐欺罪，判1年2月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院103年度上易字第574號刑事判決

trail_en: A husband holds life policies with injury riders; his wife is the beneficiary.
One afternoon he goes to a paid fishing pond, chatting cheerfully with the others.
He's pulled from the water and dies in hospital.
The insurer refuses NT$1.2M: he was a strong swimmer, and it blames heart disease.
trail_zh: 丈夫保了壽險加傷害險，受益人是妻子。
那天下午他到釣魚池釣魚，還跟其他釣客有說有笑。
他落水被救起，送醫不治。
保險公司拒付120萬：他水性很好，應是心血管疾病。
cracks_en: The bank dropped steeply straight into water 2.1 metres deep
The pond keeper said he was cheerful that afternoon
The death certificate listed the manner as 'unconfirmed'
The examiner's report mentioned heart disease as a factor
cracks_zh: 池邊陡坡直落2.1公尺深水
釣魚池管理人說他那天心情很好
相驗證明書的死亡方式寫「未確認」
相驗報告提到心血管疾病的可能
reveal_en: Anglers sat right on a slope you couldn't stand on; no clinic had ever treated him for his heart. Accident — pay NT$1.2M. Final.
reveal_zh: 釣位緊貼站不住的陡坡，他也從沒看過心血管門診。法院認定意外，判賠120萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院92年度保險上易字第8號民事判決

trail_en: A man with a chemistry background insures his new wife: NT$25M of injury cover.
He keeps bringing home leftover engine oil — and the empty cans — from the petrol station.
Visiting her parents, he complains of stomach pain and gets driven to an ER.
While he's at the hospital, the house burns. She dies in the fire.
trail_zh: 念過化工的男子替新婚妻子投保，傷害險共2,500萬。
他幾次到加油站換機油，都把剩油連罐子帶回家。
回岳家那晚，他說肚子痛，要人載去急診。
他人在醫院時，岳家起火，妻子葬身火場。
cracks_en: He'd kept bringing home the leftover oil cans
He was at an ER with stomach pain when it caught fire
GHB was found in her blood and in the cup of milk
Her mother grew suspicious once he went after the payout
cracks_zh: 他一直把剩下的機油罐帶回家
起火時他人正在急診看肚子痛
她的血液和那杯牛奶都驗出GHB
他一申請理賠，岳母就起了疑心
reveal_en: He drugged her milk and set a delayed-ignition fire to give himself an alibi. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 他在牛奶下藥，再用延遲點火裝置製造不在場證明。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院97年度台上字第6296號刑事判決

trail_en: A man's leg is badly scalded.
His story: at a friend's place he dodged the dog, tripped on the hot-plate cord and upset the hot pot.
Six insurers pay out about NT$1.08M.
The friend and the friend's uncle back up his account.
trail_zh: 男子的腿嚴重燙傷。
他說在朋友家為了閃狗，絆到電磁爐的線，打翻火鍋。
六家保險公司共賠了約108萬。
朋友和朋友的舅舅都幫他作證。
cracks_en: He said he tripped on the cord while dodging a dog
The burn was too even and complete for a spill
Six different insurers each paid out on the claim
His friend and the friend's uncle backed up his story
cracks_zh: 他說閃狗時絆到電磁爐電線
燙傷太均勻完整，不像打翻
六家不同的保險公司都付了理賠
朋友和朋友的舅舅都幫他作證
reveal_en: An accidental scald is patchy; his looked poured on deliberately. Fraud: 1 year 6 months, the helpers 1 year 2 months and 10 months. Final.
reveal_zh: 意外燙傷形狀不規則，他的傷卻像刻意澆上去的。詐欺罪：本人1年6月，幫手1年2月、10月，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院102年度上易字第901號刑事判決

trail_en: A woman holds a NT$2M personal injury policy.
She says she fell on the stairs at home; that night she's at two ERs.
Surgery for a herniated neck disc leaves her able to do light work only.
Her first claim form never mentioned a fall. The insurer: no bruises, just wear and tear.
trail_zh: 婦人有一張200萬的個人傷害險。
她說在家樓梯跌倒，當晚跑了兩家急診。
頸椎椎間盤突出開刀後，只能做輕便工作。
她第一次申請時沒提跌倒。保險公司說沒擦傷，是退化。
cracks_en: Her first claim form didn't mention any fall
She had no bruises or scrapes from the stairs
She went to two different hospital ERs that same night
The MRI showed the discs on either side weren't worn at all
cracks_zh: 她第一次申請時根本沒提到跌倒
她跌下樓梯卻沒有瘀青擦傷
她當晚連跑了兩家不同醫院的急診
核磁共振顯示鄰近椎間盤沒退化
reveal_en: Healthy neighbouring discs point to trauma, not ageing — and the ER notes that night already said she'd fallen. Insurer ordered to pay NT$800K. Final.
reveal_zh: 鄰近椎間盤健康，代表是外傷不是退化；當晚急診紀錄也寫了跌倒。判保險公司賠80萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院105年度保險上易字第4號民事判決

trail_en: A man with about NT$1.7M of card debt takes his brother, who can't hear or speak, to Hunan.
The story: visiting the brother's new wife there.
Before they leave, he buys NT$5M of injury cover through the travel agency.
The brother dies in a hotel room and is cremated in China. The claim stalls on paperwork.
trail_zh: 卡債約170萬的男子，帶著聽障又不能說話的弟弟去湖南。
理由是去看弟弟在當地娶的新太太。
出發前，他透過旅行社替弟弟買了500萬傷害險。
弟弟死在旅館房間，在大陸火化。理賠卡在文件不全。
cracks_en: He'd bought the NT$5M cover through the travel agency
The caught hitman phoned him; he promised to pay up
The brother's body was cremated before leaving China
The insurer stalled because his documents were incomplete
cracks_zh: 那500萬意外險是透過旅行社買的
落網殺手打給他，他答應付錢
弟弟的遺體在大陸就先火化了
因為文件不齊，保險公司遲遲沒賠
reveal_en: He'd hired a local man for RMB 200K, payable 'once the insurance comes through'. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 他以人民幣20萬雇用當地人行兇，說好「保險金下來就付」。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院99年度台上字第5360號刑事判決

trail_en: A claims investigator at a life insurer breaks his neck in a crash.
Afterwards he's certified as paralysed in all four limbs.
He claims from his own employer, another insurer and labour insurance.
All three refuse. He knows exactly how claims get checked.
trail_zh: 壽險公司的理賠調查員，車禍頸椎骨折。
之後他拿到四肢癱瘓的診斷。
他向自己公司、另一家保險公司和勞保申請。
三方全部拒賠。他最清楚理賠怎麼查。
cracks_en: He worked as a claims investigator for an insurer
Every one of his three claims was turned down
His neck really had been fractured in the earlier crash
His ex-boss's photos and lift CCTV showed him walking
cracks_zh: 他本身就是保險公司的理賠調查員
他提出的三筆申請全部被拒
他的頸椎確實在車禍中骨折
跟拍照片和電梯畫面都見他走路
reveal_en: The neck injury was real; the paralysis wasn't. Attempted fraud: 1 year 6 months, halved to 9 months under a commutation act. Final.
reveal_zh: 頸椎骨折是真的，癱瘓是裝的。詐欺未遂，判1年6月，依減刑條例減為9月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院104年度上易字第655號刑事判決

trail_en: A son insures his elderly mother: a NT$1.3M injury-death benefit.
Fourteen months later she goes out gathering oysters in knee-deep water.
A neighbour heads back first; later she's found in the harbour.
The insurer refuses: the forensic report mentions cardiogenic shock.
trail_zh: 兒子替年邁母親投保，傷害身故保額130萬。
14個月後，她到水深及膝的海邊採蚵。
鄰居先回港，她後來在港內被找到。
保險公司拒賠：法醫報告寫了心因性休克。
cracks_en: No clinic had ever treated her for any heart trouble
The forensic report listed cardiogenic shock as a cause
The water where she worked was only knee-deep
Her son bought the cover just 14 months earlier
cracks_zh: 她從沒因心臟問題看過任何醫生
法醫報告死因列了心因性休克
她採蚵的地方水只到膝蓋深
兒子才在14個月前替她投保
reveal_en: Mud deep in her nose showed she drowned; with no heart history, the insurer couldn't prove illness caused it. Pay NT$1.3M. Final.
reveal_zh: 鼻腔滿是泥沙，證明是溺水；她沒有心臟病史，保險公司無法證明是病發。判賠130萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院98年度保險上易字第5號民事判決

trail_en: A son who quit his job, with about NT$3.18M of debt, makes himself beneficiary of his father's policy.
He adds NT$7M of travel cover 'for a trip to Kaohsiung' that never happens.
His father, on dialysis, ends up in an irrigation canal. The son says he slipped upstream.
A couple offers to help him search downstream; he says no.
trail_zh: 負債約318萬的失業兒子，把父親保單受益人改成自己。
他又以「去高雄玩」為由加保700萬旅平險，旅行根本沒成行。
洗腎的父親落入灌溉圳溝。兒子說他在上游滑倒。
路過的夫婦要載他去找，他拒絕了。
cracks_en: The Kaohsiung trip on the travel policy never happened
He turned down a couple's offer to help him search
His father was on dialysis when a policy was 'signed'
The insurers found many doubts in his claims
cracks_zh: 旅平險上的高雄之行從沒成行
路過夫婦想載他找人，他卻拒絕
保單「簽名」時，父親其實正在洗腎
保險公司對他的理賠疑點重重
reveal_en: He forged his father's signatures, then pushed him into the canal. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 他偽簽父親的名字投保，再把父親推下圳溝。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院100年度台上字第4867號刑事判決

trail_en: A man rents a steel-framed shed and opens a 'gift warehouse'.
He insures the stock inside for NT$6M against fire.
Months later, around midnight, it burns down. The fire spreads to a hardware shop where a couple is asleep.
Next morning he reports the loss to the insurer.
trail_zh: 男子租下一間鐵架平房，開了「禮品倉庫」。
他替裡面的貨物保了600萬火險。
幾個月後半夜大火，還延燒到有夫妻在睡覺的五金行。
隔天早上他就向保險公司報案。
cracks_en: No sign of a wiring fault was found near the origin
The 'stock' was two suitcases and piles of foam matting
The fire spread to a hardware shop with a couple asleep
His partner couldn't be found, and his house had been razed
cracks_zh: 起火處附近沒發現電線短路痕跡
「貨物」只有兩只旅行箱和泡棉
火還延燒到有夫妻在睡覺的五金行
同夥找不到人，住處已被夷平
reveal_en: His partner lit the foam under the middle rack; there was nothing of value to lose. Arson for insurance, upheld; police moved before a claim was filed.
reveal_zh: 同夥在中間鐵架下點燃泡棉，裡面根本沒有值錢貨。放火詐保罪名定讞，警方介入，保險金沒領到。

source.id: 最高法院95年度台上字第5982號刑事判決

trail_en: A woman is covered by NT$1M of group injury insurance through her father's job.
On a December evening she goes for a walk at a beach park.
Fishermen catching eels nearby pull her from the sea; she can't be saved.
The insurer refuses, pointing to her medical history: why was she in the water at all?
trail_zh: 女子透過父親工作單位，有100萬團體傷害險。
12月的傍晚，她到黃金海岸散步。
附近捕鰻苗的漁民把她從海裡救起，仍然不治。
保險公司拒賠，搬出她的病史：她怎麼會在海裡？
cracks_en: The insurer pointed to her psychiatric medical history
The death certificate listed the manner of death as unknown
The fishermen said they hadn't seen her playing in the water
The insurer's own report said the spot had deadly currents
cracks_zh: 保險公司提出她的精神科病史
相驗證明書的死亡方式寫「不詳」
撈起她的漁民說沒看到她玩水
保險公司自己的報告說水流險惡
reveal_en: Two currents meet there at high tide — even the insurer's local office concluded it was likely an accident. Pay NT$1M. Final.
reveal_zh: 那裡是兩股潮水交會處，又正逢漲潮；連保險公司自己的通訊處都認為多半是意外。判賠100萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院99年度保險上易字第9號民事判決

trail_en: A woman has long resented her ex-husband. Her friend owes a creditor money.
Over NT$31M of cover appears on the ex-husband, signed in his name by others.
Twice he's talked into trips to mainland China. Twice he comes home fine.
In April 2000, on a third trip, he never comes home from Guangdong.
trail_zh: 女子對前夫積怨已久，她的朋友又欠了債主錢。
前夫名下冒出3,100萬保單，都是別人替他簽的名。
他兩度被說服去大陸旅遊，兩次都平安回來。
2000年4月第三趟，他再也沒從廣東回來。
cracks_en: His signatures on all the policy forms had been forged
His first two trips to China passed without incident
A note with her thumbprint pledged NT$22M
She had signed a 'safekeeping' IOU for NT$14.4M
cracks_zh: 保單上他的簽名全被偽造
前兩趟大陸行他都平安回來
指紋字條：願出2,200萬
她簽過1,440萬的「保管條」
reveal_en: The note promised NT$22M of the NT$31M to 'deal with' him. Murder: life imprisonment for her and the creditor, upheld.
reveal_zh: 字條寫明3,100萬保險金中拿出2,200萬「處理」前夫。殺人罪，她與債主均判無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院92年度台上字第5186號刑事判決

trail_en: 4:20am: a borrowed car slams into a lorry parked by the road.
The driver goes home without calling the police.
His wife heads to the scene and tells officers she was driving.
Two days later she files a damage claim with the car's insurer.
trail_zh: 凌晨4點20分，一台借來的車撞上路邊停放的大貨車。
駕駛沒報警，直接回家。
他太太跑到現場，跟警察說是她開的。
兩天後，她向車子的保險公司申請理賠。
cracks_en: The claims handler pulled CCTV footage of the scene
The car was borrowed from a friend of the wife's
She signed a form letting the insurer pull any records
The lorry had been left parked at the roadside
cracks_zh: 理賠人員調閱現場監視錄影
那台車是太太向朋友借來的
她簽了同意書讓保險公司調資料
被撞的大貨車停在路邊
reveal_en: The footage showed the husband at the wheel — a hit-and-run the policy doesn't cover. Attempted fraud: husband 5 months, wife 4 months. Final.
reveal_zh: 畫面拍到開車的是丈夫——肇事逃逸本來就不賠。詐欺未遂：丈夫5月、妻子4月，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院114年度上易字第418號刑事判決

trail_en: A son holds a family policy covering both parents: NT$1M of injury cover on his father.
His father, insured as a low-risk worker, now does high-risk work.
In April 2008 his father dies in a fall at work.
The insurer pays only NT$285K: the job change was never reported, it says.
trail_zh: 兒子替父母投保，父親的傷害險保額100萬。
父親投保時是低風險職業，後來改做高風險工作。
2008年4月，父親工作時從高處墜落身亡。
保險公司只賠28萬多：說職業變更從沒通知。
cracks_en: The father's new job carried a higher risk rating
The clerk said she couldn't recall what they came in for
Counter CCTV showed a clerk tear up the change form
The mother changed her name at the counter that day
cracks_zh: 父親的新工作屬於較高風險職業
承辦員說她不記得他們來辦什麼
櫃台監視器拍到職員撕掉變更單
母親當天也在櫃台辦了改名
reveal_en: Father and son came in a month earlier; the clerk checked her screen, said no change was needed and binned the form. Insurer ordered to pay the other NT$714,660. Final.
reveal_zh: 父子一個月前就到櫃台辦過；職員查完電腦說不必變更，把表格撕了丟掉。判保險公司補賠71萬4,660元，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院98年度保險上易字第9號民事判決

trail_en: After a divorce and rows over alimony, a man starts insuring his ex-wife.
Within two weeks he adds over NT$10M of cover, naming himself.
One insurer refuses — an ex-husband as beneficiary is a red flag.
He phones offering alimony and sets a meeting. That night she dies in a 'car crash'.
trail_zh: 離婚後為贍養費起衝突，男子開始替前妻投保。
兩週內加保超過1,000萬，受益人都是他。
有一家保險公司拒保：前夫當受益人，風險太高。
他打電話約她談贍養費。當晚她死於一場「車禍」。
cracks_en: A plate that fell off at the scene led to the renter
One insurer had refused to cover her at all
He'd used alimony as the excuse to set up the meeting
The first crew he hired took cash but never acted
cracks_zh: 現場掉落的車牌查出租車的人
有一家保險公司直接拒保
他用贍養費當藉口約她出來見面
第一批人收了錢卻始終沒動手
reveal_en: Three cars, one plan — and a rental car's plate left on the road. The ex-husband died before he could be charged; the recruiter and the driver got life. Upheld.
reveal_zh: 三台車分工撞人，卻在路上留下租來的車的車牌。前夫在起訴前身亡；居中找人的被告與駕駛判無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院97年度台上字第2131號刑事判決

trail_en: A man flying to see his wife in Fujian takes out NT$30M of travel cover.
One policy is bought at the airport; his daughter arranges the other.
The day after he lands, in the evening, he staggers home with a severe hand injury.
His story: three robbers attacked him and took his watch.
trail_zh: 男子去福建探望妻子，出發前買了3,000萬旅平險。
一張在機場櫃台買，另一張由女兒代辦。
抵達隔天晚上，他手部重傷，走回妻子家。
他說：三個搶匪持刀攻擊，搶走他的手錶。
cracks_en: He'd bought a cleaver at a hardware shop that morning
Blood at the scene held lidocaine, a local anaesthetic
Forensics said the hand was held still when it was cut
His daughter arranged one of the two travel policies
cracks_zh: 他當天早上在五金店買了一把剁刀
現場血跡驗出麻醉藥利多卡因
鑑定說受傷時那隻手是固定不動的
兩張旅平險其中一張由女兒代辦
reveal_en: He numbed his own hand before injuring it. Both insurers refused. Attempted fraud: 10 months in total, final.
reveal_zh: 他先麻醉自己的手，再自己動手。兩家保險公司都拒賠。詐欺未遂，合計10月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院103年度上易字第2542號刑事判決

trail_en: A neighbourhood-watch volunteer is covered by NT$1.4M of group injury insurance.
After a midday shift he joins the team for a meal with drinks at a member's home.
During the meal he suddenly vomits, and dies before reaching hospital.
The insurer pays NT$100K of term life but refuses the injury cover.
trail_zh: 守望相助隊員有140萬團體傷害險。
中午執勤完，他和隊友到隊長弟弟家聚餐喝酒。
席間他突然嘔吐，送到醫院前就走了。
保險公司只付10萬定期壽險，傷害險拒賠。
cracks_en: A review board noted that he had been diabetic
The death certificate said cardiogenic shock
He'd been drinking with the team at the meal
Paramedics had to clear vomit from his blocked airway
cracks_zh: 評議中心指出他生前有糖尿病
相驗書寫的死因是心因性休克
他聚餐時和隊友喝了不少酒
救護員從他呼吸道清出嘔吐物
reveal_en: Choking on vomit is an external, sudden event — not an illness. Insurer ordered to pay NT$1.4M. Final.
reveal_zh: 嘔吐物堵住呼吸道是外來突發事故，不是疾病。判保險公司賠140萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院103年度保險上易字第13號民事判決

trail_en: An insurance agent's marriage is failing; she's seeing another man.
She takes out NT$5M of injury cover on her husband, naming herself.
A conman takes NT$500K from the pair, promising to 'take care of' him, and does nothing.
One July dawn, the husband is found dead on his way to work.
trail_zh: 保險業務員婚姻不睦，和另一個男人交往。
她替丈夫保了500萬傷害險，受益人是自己。
有人收了兩人50萬，說要「處理」掉丈夫，卻沒動手。
七月某天清晨，丈夫在上班途中身亡。
cracks_en: A conman had taken NT$500K and never acted
Two of the attackers' shoes were left at the scene
Her lover's note: 'Once it's done, I want the money'
She'd told them when he left home and his scooter plate
cracks_zh: 有人收了50萬說要動手，卻沒行動
兩名行兇者的鞋子掉在現場
情夫字條：「做完就要拿到錢」
她把丈夫出門時間和車牌告訴對方
reveal_en: The lover hired four men, to be paid from the NT$5M. The handwritten note tied the killing to the policy. Murder, upheld.
reveal_zh: 情夫找來四人行兇，說好用那500萬分錢。親筆字條把命案和保單連在一起。殺人罪定讞。

source.id: 最高法院95年度台上字第5676號刑事判決

trail_en: A red-light runner knocks down a woman; she has a head injury.
Two years later her doctor certifies left-side paralysis: unable to work, ever.
Two insurers refuse. A third pays for a lesser grade.
In court, a hospital evaluation backs her — the top disability grade.
trail_zh: 闖紅燈的車撞倒婦人，她頭部受傷。
兩年後醫師開出左側偏癱：終身無工作能力。
兩家保險公司拒賠，第三家只賠較低等級。
打官司時，醫院鑑定支持她是最高失能等級。
cracks_en: A hospital evaluation rated her at the top disability grade
Two of the three insurers flatly refused to pay her
She dropped a lawsuit claim she had already won
Insurer videos showed her riding a scooter, carrying bags
cracks_zh: 醫院鑑定她達到最高失能等級
其中兩家保險公司直接拒賠
她放棄了一筆已勝訴的請求
跟拍影片中她騎機車、提東西
reveal_en: Three doctors watched the footage and agreed: no way that's grade 3. Fraud: 2 years, suspended 5 years. Final.
reveal_zh: 三位醫師看過影片一致認為：絕不可能是三級失能。詐欺罪，判2年、緩刑5年定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院103年度上易字第579號刑事判決

trail_en: A construction-union member has group injury cover.
His scooter is rear-ended; he's thrown into a car ahead.
Months later he reports a numb face, choking when he drinks, and hearing loss.
He claims NT$900K for permanent nerve damage. The insurer: nothing links it to the crash.
trail_zh: 營造業工會會員保了團體傷害險。
他騎機車被追撞，整個人撞上前車。
幾個月後他說臉麻、喝水會嗆、聽力受損。
他申請永久神經損傷90萬，保險公司說跟車禍無關。
cracks_en: Nursing notes logged daily vomiting and dizziness
His first hospital recorded no head injury at all
He waited seven months before seeing a specialist
The car in front had turned out suddenly into his path
cracks_zh: 護理紀錄：車禍後天天嘔吐頭暈
第一家醫院沒記錄任何頭部外傷
他隔了七個月才去看專科醫師
前車是突然轉出來擋住他的
reveal_en: Daily vomiting and dizziness fit a concussion, and scans showed no disease to blame instead. Insurer ordered to pay NT$900K. Final.
reveal_zh: 天天嘔吐頭暈符合腦震盪，影像也找不到其他病因。判保險公司賠90萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院102年度保險上易字第10號民事判決

trail_en: A man down on his luck takes out NT$14.9M of life and injury cover.
One beneficiary: his brother, who is deep in debt.
The brother's ex-wife offers to help him chase a debt, and buys him a papaya milk.
That evening he's found dead by the coastal highway; the car he rode in is gone.
trail_zh: 諸事不順的男子投保壽險和傷害險共1,490萬。
受益人之一是他負債累累的弟弟。
弟弟的前妻說要陪他去討債，還買了木瓜牛奶給他。
當晚他被發現死在西濱公路旁，載他的車不見了。
cracks_en: Two passing drivers saw a car speed away from the lights
CCTV gave the plate; his DNA was found inside that car
She'd bought a papaya milk and handed it to him
The man she recruited had heavy credit-card debts
cracks_zh: 兩名路過駕駛看到一台車快速離開
監視器查出車號，車內有他DNA
她買了木瓜牛奶拿給他喝
她找的幫手背著大筆卡債
reveal_en: She'd promised the driver NT$2M once the insurance paid. Murder: both life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 她答應事成後給駕駛200萬。殺人罪，兩人均判無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院96年度台上字第3763號刑事判決

trail_en: In March 1998 a businessman signs a three-year lease on a factory warehouse.
Days later his cheque account is down to NT$1,089; the bank blacklists him.
He fills it with stock, insures it heavily, and has a security system installed.
Eleven days after the alarm goes in, the warehouse burns to the ground.
trail_zh: 1998年3月，商人簽下三年的廠房倉庫租約。
幾天後，他的支票帳戶只剩1,089元，被列為拒絕往來戶。
他把貨搬進去、保了高額火險，還裝了保全。
保全裝好11天後，倉庫燒成平地。
cracks_en: He was at a bowling alley when the fire broke out
A barred window near the origin had been sawn
A cheque he'd written for a premium had bounced
The 'high-end' stock was cheap goods valued at NT$47.7M
cracks_zh: 起火時他人在保齡球館打球
起火點附近一扇窗的鐵條被鋸開
他繳保費的支票後來被退票
低價貨充高級品，報值4,766萬
reveal_en: No direct proof — but the debts, the junk stock, the huge cover and his keys added up. Arson for insurance, upheld.
reveal_zh: 沒有直接證據，但負債、爛貨、鉅額保險和鑰匙全兜得起來。放火詐保罪名定讞。

source.id: 最高法院98年度台上字第6563號刑事判決

trail_en: A man with a history of fainting and epilepsy checks into a mountain hot-spring hotel.
He's covered by an injury policy and a travel policy.
Staff at the hot spring see him unsteady on the stairs and warn him not to soak.
By evening he has drowned in the pool. The insurer refuses: illness, not an outside cause.
trail_zh: 男子有昏倒、癲癇病史，入住山區溫泉飯店。
他保了傷害險和旅行平安險。
溫泉員工看他上樓不穩，勸他不舒服就別泡。
傍晚他溺斃池中。保險公司拒賠：是病不是外來事故。
cracks_en: The examiner listed the manner of death as 'accident'
Old hospital records showed fainting and epilepsy
A staff member saw him unsteady on his way to the pool
The water came up to his chest when he sat down
cracks_zh: 相驗書的死亡方式寫「意外」
病歷記載他曾有昏倒和癲癇
員工看到他走去泡湯時步伐不穩
坐下時水深到他的胸口
reveal_en: Old records weren't proof a seizure caused this drowning. Insurer ordered to pay NT$550K. Final.
reveal_zh: 多年前的病歷不能證明這次是發病溺水。判保險公司賠55萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院94年度保險上易字第4號民事判決

trail_en: A builder employs his uncle, who has an intellectual disability, as a guard — titled 'manager'.
In eight months he takes out about 17 injury policies on him.
A friend, newly hired, drives the uncle into a power pole. He survives.
Against medical advice, the family moves him to a care home. He dies within a week.
trail_zh: 建商僱用智能障礙的舅舅當警衛，掛名「經理」。
八個月內替舅舅投保約17張傷害險。
剛入職的朋友開車載舅舅撞電線桿，舅舅沒死。
家屬不顧醫師反對讓他出院轉安養中心，一週內過世。
cracks_en: The driver had once claimed NT$9M for a hand injury
One insurer cancelled after spotting the other policies
His diabetes medicine was withheld from the care home
The driver insisted he go to one particular hospital
cracks_zh: 那名駕駛曾為手傷求償900萬
有保險公司發現重複投保就解約
糖尿病藥被扣住，沒交給安養中心
駕駛堅持要送某一家特定醫院
reveal_en: When the crash didn't kill him, they let his diabetes do it. Murder: life for the nephew, 12 years for his brother. Upheld.
reveal_zh: 車禍沒撞死，就讓糖尿病惡化致死。殺人罪：外甥無期徒刑、其弟12年，定讞。

source.id: 最高法院98年度台上字第105號刑事判決

trail_en: A man in rural Tainan carries a large amount of insurance.
Twice in January he's got drunk and a vehicle comes at him. Twice he survives.
In February a woman drives him to a radish field to drink with the workers.
That night a lorry runs him down on the road. The insurance pays out.
trail_zh: 台南一名男子保了高額保險。
一月間他兩度喝醉後被車衝撞，兩次都沒事。
二月，一名女子載他到蘿蔔田和工人喝酒。
當晚一台大貨車在路上撞死他，保險金照付。
cracks_en: He'd survived two drunken 'accidents' in January
The field owner got NT$6.3M of the payout
The woman phoned ahead to say she'd brought him
A lorry driver hit him on the road that night
cracks_zh: 他一月兩次酒後「意外」都活下來
田主拿到630萬保險金
女子事先打電話說人已經載到
當晚一名大貨車司機撞上他
reveal_en: The field owner kept NT$3.8M and passed NT$2.2M to the driver. Murder: the woman 17 years, the field owner 14, the driver 9. Upheld.
reveal_zh: 田主自留380萬，再轉220萬給司機。殺人罪：女子17年、田主14年、司機9年定讞。

source.id: 最高法院97年度台上字第2963號刑事判決

trail_en: A woman in debt has signed a man's land over to her creditor.
He demands it back by a deadline. His son is due to handle the paperwork that day.
That morning she drives him to a hot-spring motel, though he has a heart condition.
An hour later she calls the staff. He can't be revived.
trail_zh: 負債的女子把一名男子的土地過戶給了債主。
他限期要她還，當天兒子正要辦過戶。
那天早上她載他去溫泉汽車旅館，他有心臟病。
一小時後她才通知員工，他已救不回來。
cracks_en: He had a serious heart condition, with stents
She delayed opening the door when staff arrived
She failed a polygraph on whether she drugged him
Sleeping pills he'd never been given were in him and his cup
cracks_zh: 他有嚴重心臟病，裝過支架
員工趕到時，她拖延不開門
她測謊「有沒有下藥」沒過
他沒拿過的安眠藥出現在體內和水杯
reveal_en: He'd never been prescribed the sleeping pill; she had. Murder: 13 years, upheld.
reveal_zh: 他從沒拿過那種安眠藥，她有。殺人罪，判13年定讞。

source.id: 最高法院104年度台上字第3053號刑事判決

trail_en: May 2006: a man introduces his girlfriend to an insurance agent.
Her new policy pays NT$10M on an injury death. Weeks later, his young daughter becomes the beneficiary.
By autumn the couple have split up, but they still meet. In October they stay at a Kenting motel.
Two days later she is found dead. Her blood holds alcohol, meth and a sedative.
trail_zh: 2006年5月，男子介紹女友認識一名保險業務員。
她的新保單傷害身故賠1000萬。幾週後，受益人改成他年幼的女兒。
入秋後兩人分手，但仍有往來。10月，兩人同住墾丁一間汽車旅館。
兩天後她被發現身亡，血中驗出酒精、安非他命和鎮靜劑。
cracks_en: The agent said he was there at every step of the policy
Her sedative level was above the usual lethal threshold
Her stomach held no swallowed water at all, the autopsy said
Hardly any lividity could be seen on her body
cracks_zh: 業務員說投保每一步他都在場
她體內鎮靜劑超過一般致死濃度
解剖發現她胃裡沒有吞入的水
她身上幾乎看不出屍斑
reveal_en: The agent testified that the man was present at the signing, the medical check and the premium payments, so he knew the NT$10M terms and who would collect. He confessed and led police to the weapon. Murder conviction upheld.
reveal_zh: 業務員證稱，簽約、體檢、繳費時男子都在場，他清楚1000萬的理賠條件與受益人是誰。他坦承犯行並帶警方找到凶器。殺人罪定讞。

source.id: 最高法院99年度台上字第6042號刑事判決

trail_en: 1:45am, May 2010: a Cadillac and a BMW collide in Pingtung.
The Cadillac ends up in a shrimp pond; the BMW's front is smashed.
A woman tells police she was the one driving the BMW.
The insurer pays NT$1.7M: the pond owner, the Cadillac and BMW repairs.
trail_zh: 2010年5月凌晨1點45分，一輛凱迪拉克和一輛BMW在屏東相撞。
凱迪拉克衝進蝦池，BMW車頭撞爛。
一名女子向警方說BMW是她開的。
保險公司賠了170萬：池主、凱迪拉克和BMW修車費。
cracks_en: The Cadillac carried unusually heavy insurance cover
She said he called her hours before, came back soaking wet
The BMW was a friend's car and was already damaged
The pond owner received NT$120,000 for the damage
cracks_zh: 凱迪拉克投保了高額車險
她說他事前就來找她，渾身濕透
BMW是朋友的車，早已撞壞
蝦池主人另獲賠12萬元
reveal_en: Her own statement gave it away: the car dealer had phoned her about three hours before the stated crash time and came back drenched. The crash was staged and she stood in as driver. 新光產險 paid NT$1,708,900. Dealer 1 year, her 5 months. Final.
reveal_zh: 她自己的供述露了餡：車商在報案的事故時間約三小時前就打給她，回來時全身濕透。車禍是假造的，她頂替當駕駛。新光產險賠了170萬8900元。車商判1年，她5個月，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院108年度上易字第79號刑事判決

trail_en: Dec 2008: a man soaks at a hot-spring hotel in Jiaoxi.
He is found face-down and unconscious in the pool.
He had diabetes and high blood pressure.
Two insurers refuse: a heart attack, they say, nothing more.
trail_zh: 2008年12月，男子在礁溪溫泉旅館泡湯。
他被發現臉朝下、昏迷在池中。
他有糖尿病和高血壓。
兩家保險公司拒賠：說是心肌梗塞，僅此而已。
cracks_en: A National Taiwan University opinion backed the insurers
His CK-MB heart enzyme read 33.6, above the 25 ceiling
The examiner recorded a slip and bruising before the attack
ER staff suctioned water and food from his airway
cracks_zh: 保險公司引用台大的鑑定意見
心肌酶數值33.6，高於上限25
相驗記載先滑倒挫傷才心梗
急診從他呼吸道抽出水和食物
reveal_en: The examiner's report put a slip first, with bruises to his left elbow and chest, then the heart attack, and ruled the manner accidental. Doctors said the enzyme rise wasn't meaningful. Taiwan Life pays NT$1M, Cathay NT$200K. Final.
reveal_zh: 相驗報告記載他先滑倒、左肘和胸部挫傷，之後才心肌梗塞，死亡方式為意外；醫師也說心肌酶並無明顯升高。台灣人壽賠100萬、國泰20萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院100年度保險上易字第20號民事判決

trail_en: May 2020: a BMW still under a car loan vanishes from a Taipei car park.
Its owner reports it stolen that night, and claims five days later.
The insurer pays NT$1.45M straight to the lender in July.
The owner's friend says he wasn't anywhere near the car park.
trail_zh: 2020年5月，一輛還在繳車貸的BMW在台北停車場不見了。
車主當晚報案失竊，五天後申請理賠。
保險公司7月把145萬直接匯給貸款銀行。
車主的朋友說他當天根本不在那附近。
cracks_en: The owner only reported the theft at 9:39 that night
CCTV at two car parks showed the friend taking it
The payout went straight to the bank to clear the loan
He changed clothes and took a taxi partway, footage showed
cracks_zh: 車主晚上9點39分才報案失竊
兩處停車場監視器拍到朋友開走
理賠金直接匯給銀行清償車貸
他中途換衣服再搭計程車
reveal_en: Cameras at two car parks traced the friend: he parked elsewhere, changed, took a taxi, and drove the BMW out at 11:37 with its key fob. Friend 6 months; owner 7 months, suspended 3 years. Final.
reveal_zh: 兩處停車場的監視器拍下朋友的行蹤：他把車停在別處、換衣服、搭計程車，11點37分拿遙控鑰匙把BMW開走。朋友判6個月，車主7個月緩刑3年，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院111年度上易字第1608號刑事判決

trail_en: 1996: a father takes out NT$1.5M of injury cover on himself.
In 2004 he makes his two sons equal beneficiaries.
Jan 2014: he is found at home with his head in a basin of water.
The insurer refuses: a burst aneurysm, it says, and the basin was shallow.
trail_zh: 1996年，父親替自己投保150萬傷害險。
2004年他把受益人改成兩個兒子平分。
2014年1月，他在家被發現頭浸在水盆裡。
保險公司拒賠：說是動脈瘤破裂，水盆又很淺。
cracks_en: The basin held only ten-odd centimetres of water
There wasn't even a slight bruise anywhere on him
The toxicology form ticked both illness and drowning
The autopsy found he drowned before the bleed could kill
cracks_zh: 水盆裡的水只有十幾公分深
他身上連輕微瘀傷都沒有
毒物鑑定單同時勾病死與溺斃
解剖認定出血致命前已先溺斃
reveal_en: The bleed may have made him collapse, but the autopsy found drowning came first: an outside, sudden cause. Each son gets NT$750K from 遠雄人壽. Final.
reveal_zh: 出血也許讓他倒下，但解剖認定他是先溺斃，屬外來突發事故。遠雄人壽須賠兩個兒子各75萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院104年度保險上易字第2號民事判決

trail_en: Aug 1996, about 10pm: a man and his wife go out driving in Chiayi.
Later the car is found against a concrete barrier, she in the driver's seat. She has died.
He gets home in a coworker's car, and later says police told him of the "crash".
Insurers pay out more than NT$11.4M on her life.
trail_zh: 1996年8月晚上10點左右，男子和妻子在嘉義開車外出。
車子後來被發現抵著水泥護欄，她在駕駛座上，已經身亡。
他搭同事的車回家，事後說是警方通知他出了「車禍」。
多家保險公司就她的死亡賠出逾1143萬元。
cracks_en: Her injuries didn't fit the car's slight bumper dent
A coworker and his wife drove him home that same night
Her sister was the named beneficiary on two of the policies
His first wife's death, back in 1985, had also paid out
cracks_zh: 她的傷勢與輕微車損對不上
同事夫妻當晚開車送他回家
其中兩張保單受益人是她妹妹
首任妻子1985年死也獲理賠
reveal_en: A wound at her left temple, no chest injuries, and only a slight dent at the right-front bumper: the forensic examiner overturned the accident finding. Arrested in another inquiry in 2003, he confessed. Murder conviction upheld.
reveal_zh: 她左太陽穴有傷、胸部無傷，車子只有右前保險桿輕微凹陷，法醫推翻了車禍意外的認定。他2003年因其他案件被查時坦承犯行。殺人罪定讞。

source.id: 最高法院97年度台上字第1121號刑事判決

trail_en: 2004: a company insures its Tainan plant with three insurers.
Five second-hand injection-moulding machines are brought in.
A fire guts the plant. The machines are listed among the losses.
Insurers pay out NT$27.5M, backed by invoices for the machines.
trail_zh: 2004年，一家公司替台南廠房向三家保險公司投保。
廠裡搬進五台二手射出成型機。
一場大火燒毀廠房，機器列入損失清單。
保險公司依機器發票賠出2750萬。
cracks_en: The loss adjuster was paid NT$7.5M by the company
A dinner guest said one partner left at about 2am
Police seized a sheet setting out how to split the payout
Three name cards were printed for made-up people
cracks_zh: 公證人收了公司750萬元
飯局客人說合夥人約凌晨2點走
查扣一張「保險金分配表」
另印了三張虛構人物的名片
reveal_en: The seized "payout split sheet" carved up the claim among the plotters, the loss adjuster included. The NT$7.7M of machine invoices were written after the fire. Sentences of 6½ years, 6 years and less. Final.
reveal_zh: 查扣的「保險金分配表」把理賠金分給共犯，連公證人都有份。770萬的機器發票是火災後才開的。主謀判6年6月、公證人6年，其餘較輕，定讞。

source.id: 最高法院99年度台上字第6906號刑事判決

trail_en: Her child takes out NT$1M of injury cover on a mother of 72.
April 2019: she falls two days running at home.
Her right foot swells; cellulitis sets in, and she dies of sepsis.
The insurer refuses: the certificate says natural causes.
trail_zh: 子女替72歲的母親投保100萬傷害險。
2019年4月，她在家連續兩天跌倒。
她右腳腫起、蜂窩性組織炎，最後敗血症過世。
保險公司拒賠：死亡證明書寫自然死。
cracks_en: The death certificate gave the manner as natural
A university hospital said the infection wasn't from a fall
An April 8 check-up showed no sign of any infection
She had already had cellulitis once, back in 2017
cracks_zh: 死亡證明書上寫的是自然死
成大說感染不是跌倒造成
4月8日回診時並無感染跡象
她2017年就得過蜂窩性組織炎
reveal_en: At an April 8 check-up, days before the falls, there was no sign of infection, so the court traced the cellulitis to the falls. 旺旺友聯 pays NT$1M. Final.
reveal_zh: 4月8日、跌倒前幾天的回診並無感染跡象，法院因此認定蜂窩性組織炎由跌倒引起。旺旺友聯須賠100萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院110年度保險上易字第1號民事判決

trail_en: A man is invited to invest in a Taoyuan hotel and named its "manager".
The building is insured with Hua Nan for NT$80M.
A fire starts on the 4th floor, by a spa's machine room door.
The "manager" files the claim; the insurer pays about NT$6M.
trail_zh: 男子受邀投資桃園一家賓館，掛名「經理」。
大樓向華南投保8000萬。
四樓藥浴機房門口附近起火。
「經理」出面申請理賠，保險公司賠了約600萬。
cracks_en: Lab tests found a petrol-type accelerant at the origin
The fire began near the door of the spa's machine room
The "manager" had only been invited in as an investor
The hotel was covered for as much as NT$80M
cracks_zh: 起火點驗出汽油類助燃劑
火從藥浴機房門口附近燒起
那位「經理」原本只是受邀投資
賓館投保金額高達8000萬
reveal_en: Gas chromatography found a petrol-type accelerant where the fire began: it had been set. The "manager" was a front, pushed into claiming. The arsonist got 7 years 10 months overall; the front, 4 years 8 months. Final.
reveal_zh: 氣相層析在起火點驗出汽油類助燃劑：火是人放的。那位「經理」只是人頭，被逼出面請款。縱火者合併判7年10月，人頭4年8月，定讞。

source.id: 最高法院99年度台上字第5284號刑事判決

trail_en: June 2012: a man is admitted to a Miaoli hospital with a stroke.
It has weakened his right side; a CT scan shows no bleeding.
June 10: he falls in the ward bathroom and cuts his forehead.
A brain bleed follows; he dies days later. The insurer blames the stroke.
trail_zh: 2012年6月，男子因中風住進苗栗一家醫院。
中風讓他右側無力，電腦斷層並無出血。
6月10日，他在病房浴室跌倒，額頭割傷。
隨後腦出血，幾天後過世。保險公司歸咎中風。
cracks_en: His admission CT scan showed no bleeding at all
The gash was on his left; the stroke weakened his right
He was on aspirin and heparin, both of them blood thinners
The bathroom fall happened five days into his stay
cracks_zh: 入院時電腦斷層並無出血
傷在左額，中風無力卻在右側
他在用阿斯匹靈和肝素
住院第五天在浴室跌倒
reveal_en: A fall caused by the stroke would have gone toward his weakened right side; the 3cm gash was on his left. Taipei Veterans General said the fall most likely caused the bleed. 新光產物 pays NT$1M to his wife and daughter. Final.
reveal_zh: 若是中風導致跌倒，應倒向無力的右側，但3公分的傷口在左額。北榮認為腦出血最可能是跌倒所致。新光產物須賠妻女100萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院102年度保險上易字第15號民事判決

trail_en: A paint company owner sinks deep into debt.
Feb 21, 1991: he takes out yet another policy on his own life.
That night his pickup hits his factory wall and burns. The body inside wears his watch and pager.
His wife claims; insurers pay out about NT$5.48M.
trail_zh: 一家油漆公司老闆債台高築。
1991年2月21日，他又替自己加保一張壽險。
當晚他的貨車撞上自家工廠圍牆起火，車內遺體戴著他的手錶和呼叫器。
妻子申請理賠，保險公司共賠約548萬元。
cracks_en: The pickup was carrying nine drums of industrial toluene
His wife filed the first claims just four days later
He had bought a new policy that very same day
He was later caught alive over a theft, and confessed
cracks_zh: 貨車上載著九桶工業用甲苯
妻子事發四天後就申請理賠
出事當天他才剛買新保單
他後來因竊案落網，人還活著
reveal_en: The man in the truck was a stranger he had lured from near Taichung station with a job offer. He fled to Tainan; caught alive for a theft, he confessed. Murder and fraud conviction upheld.
reveal_zh: 車內死者是他在台中車站附近以工作為由騙來的陌生人。他逃到台南，後來因竊案被捕，人還活著，並坦承一切。殺人及詐欺罪定讞。

source.id: 最高法院85年度台上字第1213號刑事判決

trail_en: Aug 2016: a man buys a NT$1.7M BMW in a friend's name.
It is fully insured, theft included, for about NT$2.5M.
Dec 2016: after a night out at a Yilan karaoke bar, the BMW is gone.
The friend reports it stolen; the insurer pays NT$2.27M.
trail_zh: 2016年8月，男子用朋友名義買了一輛170萬的BMW。
車子保了含竊盜險的全險，約252萬。
2016年12月，在宜蘭一家卡拉OK過夜後，BMW不見了。
朋友報案失竊，保險公司賠了227萬。
cracks_en: Business losses had left the buyer badly short of cash
The friend was promised NT$200,000 from the payout
The karaoke car park's CCTV showed who drove it away
After the payout, the car was found on a new back road
cracks_zh: 買車的人做生意虧損缺錢
報案的朋友事成可分20萬
卡拉OK停車場監視器拍到誰開走
理賠後車子出現在重劃區道路
reveal_en: The car-park cameras showed an unwitting acquaintance driving off at 23:33; the buyer had handed him the key at a temple, asking him to take the car for servicing. 1 year 6 months for fraud, plus 3 months for the false report. Final.
reveal_zh: 停車場監視器拍到一名不知情的熟人在23點33分把車開走；是買車的人在廟裡把鑰匙交給他，託他送保養。詐欺判1年6月，誣告另判3月，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院106年度上易字第2340號刑事判決

trail_en: A worker holds NT$2M of group injury cover.
March 2015: they say they slipped into a gully while working on a mountain.
Their records show earlier visits for dizzy spells.
The insurer won't pay for the stiff wrist: no proof of an outside cause.
trail_zh: 一名工作者保了200萬團體傷害險。
2015年3月，他說在山上工作時失足摔落山溝。
病歷顯示他之前多次因眩暈就診。
保險公司拒賠手腕僵硬：無法證明是外來事故。
cracks_en: Earlier visits for vertigo were on the medical record
Within the hour the ER logged a fall, with injuries all over
The insurer said the wrist could still move about 10 degrees
The suit came more than two years after the fall
cracks_zh: 病歷上有多次眩暈就診紀錄
一小時內急診就記載跌倒多處傷
保險公司說手腕還能動約10度
起訴時距跌倒已超過兩年
reveal_en: The ER record at 11:47 read "fall down while work in the mountain just now", with wounds to the head, eye, chest and hand, just what a fall looks like. 中榮 rated the wrist stiff. 新光產物 pays NT$600K (30%). Final.
reveal_zh: 11點47分的急診病歷寫著「剛剛在山上工作時跌倒」，傷及頭、眼、胸、手，與跌倒相符。中榮鑑定手腕已強直。新光產物須賠60萬（三成），定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院108年度保險上易字第1號民事判決

trail_en: Aug 2017: a woman's scooter collides with another in Taichung.
Soon she tells eye doctors she can only count fingers at 10-20cm.
Insurer staff visit her home several times; she gropes her way about.
She claims disability from three insurers, plus compulsory motor cover.
trail_zh: 2017年8月，一名女子在台中騎機車與另一輛機車擦撞。
不久她告訴眼科醫師，只能在10到20公分處數手指。
保險公司人員多次家訪，她都摸索著走動。
她向三家保險公司申請失能理賠，另請領強制險。
cracks_en: An MRI showed a blurred edge where the optic nerves cross
Her doctor wrote notes so she could get leave and a carer
She took seven hours of mobility training for the blind
She failed the hospital's test for feigned blindness
cracks_zh: MRI顯示視神經交叉處界線模糊
醫師開證明讓她請假、請看護
她上過七小時視障定向訓練
她沒通過醫院的詐盲測試
reveal_en: Veterans General Taichung found her eyes moved freely as she walked about, but froze during testing, and she failed its malingering test. Two VEP tests were normal. The first claims were paid; the later ones refused. 2 years overall. Final.
reveal_zh: 中榮發現她在室內走動時眼睛轉動自如，一做檢查就僵住，詐盲測試也沒通過；兩次視覺誘發電位都正常。第一輪理賠已付，後來的被拒。合併判2年，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院110年度上易字第907號刑事判決

trail_en: Since 1994 a man has held NT$1.5M of injury cover, for his mother.
Sept 2008, at dawn: his car heads straight across a fishing harbour.
It knocks down the quayside barrier and goes into the sea. He drowns.
His life cover pays; the injury insurer says it was deliberate.
trail_zh: 男子自1994年起保了150萬傷害險，受益人是母親。
2008年9月清晨，他的車直直開進一處漁港。
車子撞倒岸邊護欄衝入海中，他溺水身亡。
壽險已理賠，傷害險公司卻說他是故意的。
cracks_en: The examiner found he drowned alive; manner: accident
No skid marks were found anywhere at the scene
Road signs and markings pointed the way to the harbour
He had no known link to that stretch of coast
cracks_zh: 相驗認定生前溺水，屬意外
現場找不到任何煞車痕
路上有通往漁港的標誌標線
他和事發地點毫無地緣關係
reveal_en: The examiner found a live drowning after a crash, with only a chest bruise, and recorded the manner as accident. Proving intent was the insurer's burden, and it had only inference. 三商美邦 pays NT$1.5M. Final.
reveal_zh: 相驗認定是車禍落水後生前溺水，只有胸部挫傷，死亡方式為意外。要證明故意是保險公司的責任，它卻只有推測。三商美邦須賠150萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院99年度保險上易字第6號民事判決
